• Role-based access: admin, supervisor, invigilator.  
• Exportable reports (CSV/PDF).

1. Source-controlled code for mobile app and dashboard  
2. Compiled APK/IPA ready for store submission  
3. Deployment scripts (Docker or equivalent) for the backend  
4. Setup and user documentation

Acceptance criteria  
• ≥95 % face match accuracy on the supplied photo set in normal classroom lighting  
• Offline attendance capture for at least 4 hours without network
